'''Chubbray''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who lived in the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. During the battle they manned a [[Catapult/Legends|catapult]] with fellow Ewok [[Stemzee]].

==Personality and traits==
Chubbray had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown fur with a streak of white fur across their face.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Equipment==
Chubbray wore a brown hood<ref name="RotJ" /> and wielded a spear.<ref name="TVC">''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]''</ref>
